# v2026.11.20

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.20.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.20.md).

This release covers **6 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Flow can import the whole Xero sales history as read-only invoices, with their Xero numbers, one year at a time. Each year has a dry run first and an undo after. Nothing imports until an owner or admin starts a year. ([#559](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/559), [#560](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/560))
- An imported invoice shows on the Invoices page in its tab (Awaiting payment, Paid, Void), marked "Imported", with its jobs. Every imported invoice has a job. ([#561](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/561))
- Invoices that Flow made from Xero invoices before this release can become their Xero invoices, with their Xero numbers. A dry run shows each one first. ([#562](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/562))
- Void is only for an invoice a customer saw. ([#558](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/558))

## Changes

- An imported invoice is read-only: Flow never sends, voids, deletes or changes it, and never writes it to Xero. ([#559](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/559))
- The Xero history import runs in batches by year, with a dry run, a follow step for later changes in Xero, and an undo for a batch. ([#560](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/560))
- The Invoices page and the invoice page show imported invoices, and the jobs each one bills, also with the Xero adapter off. ([#561](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/561))
- An owner or admin can change each earlier made copy into its Xero invoice. The job it billed stays billed or paid, and Flow does not draft it again. ([#562](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/562))

## Fixes

- Flow voids only an invoice that reached the customer. An invoice that never reached Xero is deleted, not voided. ([#558](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/558))
